Name: Skull Cavern Drill Redux
Author: AnZaNaMa
Description:
[size=3][b]-----
Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6[/b]
﻿Version 1.1.1 should be compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
﻿Requires SMAPI 4.0.6+ and JSON Assets 1.11.6+
[b]-----[/b]

This is a fork/spinoff of the original [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6120?tab=description]Dwarven Drill/Skull Cavern Drill[/url][size=3] mod combo by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/49462938]S1mmyy[/url][size=3] which aims to make the drill more usable in a regular game.[/size]

[size=3]Adds a craftable drill that can be placed in the Skull Cavern to create shafts.[/size]

[size=3]Note - the recipes for making the drill will not be unlocked until you reach Mining Level 8.[/size]

[b][u][size=4]Items Added[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]- Dwarven Drill[/size]
[size=3]- Dwarven Drill Core (ingredient for Dwarven Drill)[/size]
[size=3]- Drill Casing (ingredient for Dwarven Drill)[/size]

[b][u][size=4]Improvements on Original Mod[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]- Attempted to balance the cost of the drill, as the original mod required a Dwarven Artifact which only comes from hoeing and geodes.[/size]
[size=3]- Recipes actually give amounts shown (the recipe in S1mmyy's mod was broken due to a limitation with Json Assets)[/size]
[size=3]- Components for the drill can be purchased from the Dwarf's shop (though it's cheaper to make them yourself)[/size]
[size=3]- Fancy new homemade textures :)[/size]

[size=4][b][u]Feedback & Bugs[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]If you find any bugs in the mod or run into any other problems, please post them on the [url=https://github.com/AndrewGraber/Skull-Cavern-Drill-Redux/issues]issues[/url] page.[/size]

[size=3]I also welcome any and all constructive feedback! I feel like the prices/recipes might need some tweaks for balance, so please let me know your opinions! Any feedback can also be posted in the issues page linked above.[/size]

[b][u][size=4]Contributors[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]If you would like to help out with the mod, feel free to submit a pull request on the [url=https://github.com/AndrewGraber/Skull-Cavern-Drill-Redux]github repo[/url] and I'll have a look![/size]
